SQS is driven by API actions/requests
evidence.quote: Every Amazon SQS action counts as a request.

evidence.proved: the maximum SQS message size is 1,048,576 bytes (1 MiB)
evidence.quote: The minimum message size is 1 byte (1 character). The maximum is 1,048,576 bytes (1 MiB).

evidence.proved: SQS message retention defaults to 4 days, with a 14-day maximum
evidence.quote: By default, a message is retained for 4 days. The minimum is 60 seconds (1 minute). The maximum is 1,209,600 seconds (14 days).

evidence.proved: same-region SQS data transfer is free; cross-region and internet transfer is charged
evidence.quote: AWS does not charge for data transfer when sending messages to Amazon SQS or receiving messages from Amazon SQS if all resources are in the same AWS region. For cross-region data transfer and data transfer to or from the internet, standard AWS Data Transfer Charges apply.

evidence.proved: SQS chains to S3 through the Extended Client Library, which stores large payloads and bills S3 storage
evidence.quote: When using the Amazon SQS Extended Client Library to send payloads using Amazon S3, you incur Amazon S3 charges for any Amazon S3 storage you use to send message payloads.
